subject: Energy
title: The Storage Problem
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Storage Problem.

hook.text: Electricity is generated and consumed in the same instant—there's no easy way to stockpile it like oil or gas.

buildup.text: Supply must match demand every second—too much power wastes energy, too little causes blackouts.

discovery.text: Energy storage bridges the gap—capturing surplus energy and releasing it when it's needed most.

twist.text: Without storage, solar energy is useless after sunset and wind energy disappears when air goes calm.

climax.text: Storage transforms intermittent renewables into reliable power—it's the missing piece of the clean energy puzzle.

punchline.text: Generate now, use later—storage makes energy flexible.

quiz.question: Why is energy storage critical for renewables?
options: It bridges gaps between generation and demand
It reduces CO₂ from solar panels
